name: fast-and-slow-pointers

steps.caption: A list whose tail loops back
slow moves 1 node per step, fast moves 2
Inside the loop the gap shrinks by 1 per step
Reset one pointer to head to find the loop start
No loop: fast reaches the end with slow in the middle

title: Floyd's tortoise and hare on a list 1→2→3→4→5→6 that loops back to 3
